summary: A standalone, easier-entry cooperative dungeon crawler that keeps Gloomhaven's card-driven combat and hand-management tension while trimming setup and rules overhead. You and up to three friends fight through a branching campaign of scenarios, retiring cards for stamina and racing the clock before your hand runs empty.
praised: much faster, friendlier onramp than base Gloomhaven
tense hand-management combat with meaningful initiative choices
criticised: still a real time investment with fiddly setup/teardown per scenario
limited character roster compared to full Gloomhaven
quarterbacking risk if one player reads all the rules

interaction.kind: cooperative coordination via simultaneous card initiative
interaction.detail: Players choose action cards secretly and reveal them together, so combo-ing abilities and managing shared initiative order is the main way characters affect each other, while the monster/map state is fully shared. Each hero still manages a private hand and character sheet independent of the others.

scoring.why: Each scenario is won or lost as a team based on completing its specific objective before running out of health, cards, or turns.
scoring.how_you_win: Work together using each character's action cards to defeat monsters, protect objectives, or escape as required by the scenario, completing it before the party is exhausted.

similar: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
